body: Added a send-only SMTP App Password path (GMAIL_SMTP_ADDRESS/GMAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD, real net/smtp + STARTTLS, no third-party dependency) to emily-agent's Gmail integration as a fallback for the existing OAuth2 refresh-token flow, which needs a one-time interactive browser consent flow the founder would have to complete manually. buildGmailClient() tries the real API first (enables read+send), falls back to SMTP (send-only) if only that's configured. Credentials go through the EXISTING generic 'emily key set' command, no new CLI subcommand needed. go test ./... (emily-agent module) passes clean. Explicit founder privacy boundary honored throughout: no email content gets logged into Apples/CHANGELOG/BACKLOG by this or any related code path.
title: Gmail integration — SMTP App Password fallback path added
